received_proposals.exact_message: I accept our mutual commitment to produce 16 units each. This agreement maximizes joint profits and sustains high prices. I will produce 16 in this round, provided you all reciprocate.
Please agree to jointly restrict output at A=16, B=16, C=16 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This specific allocation and window ensures terms cannot drift from our proposed agreement.
